title: Order contents, changes and cancellations
required_reference_topics: Approved order-content/change/cancellation branches and status restrictions.
Independent order contents, change payloads, charges and cancellation/refund outcomes.

check_conditions.procedure.information: Identify the correct order and current requested contents/change/cancellation, including corrected identifiers. Establish required identity, order/shipping state and eligibility conditions before a dependent change.
check_conditions.procedure.actions: Identify the correct order and current requested contents/change/cancellation, including corrected identifiers. Perform the authorised eligible update, cancellation, return or refund branch with correct items/values. Compare the recorded agreed operation here; required verification/eligibility/permission relationships remain in procedure.order_permission, and factual policy claims require independent eligible support in Answer support.
check_conditions.procedure.order_permission: Establish required identity, order/shipping state and eligibility conditions before a dependent change. Apply explicit order/status restrictions and honour current permission; no cancellation after an explicit withdrawal.
check_conditions.completeness: Track every requested item, order-ID correction, change and withdrawal in context. Address each requested change and any separate return/refund question.
check_conditions.completeness.promises_next_steps: Account for the current requested outcome; a withdrawn action is not still required and is not completed by withdrawal. Explain actual remaining return, refund or customer steps and supported pending commitments.
check_conditions.communication-style: Make cancellation, return, replacement, refund and confirmed order contents easy to distinguish.
check_conditions.answer-support: Authoritative order contents, status and update records plus applicable order-change/refund rules.
